_comment: Exceptions to the stagnancy timeout's launcher settings (STAGNANT_MODE and <TYPE>_STAGNANT_*), for one broker or one market on it - these win. Copy this file to stagnancy.json (gitignored) to use it; bots read it when they start. Bot types: scalper, surge-follower, index-reversion, session-breakout, commodity-trend, ema, scanner. Brokers: oanda, pepperstone, capital, ig, alpaca. Settings: mode (off / shadow / enforce), min_age, window and cooldown (90s, 15m, 2h or 4bars), range (0.05% or 0.25atr) and pnl (1.50 or 0.2R). Markets go by the broker's own symbol (IG: the epic or the market's name). Keys starting with _ are notes.

oanda._why: Close the OANDA scanner's stagnant trades for real, and keep it out of that market for 15 minutes after.

XAUUSD._why: Gold moves more than the FX pairs: a wider range still counts as going nowhere.

ig._why: IG's scalper reads prices every 10s at best: give it a longer look before calling a trade stagnant.
